newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Flooding in west Ireland costs 10 mln punts - report.
newsitem.headline: Flooding in west Ireland costs 10 mln punts - report.

text.p: Large-scale flooding in South Galway and North Clare in 1995 caused up to 10 million Irish pounds worth of damage to the area, a government report said on Friday.

The report, prepared for the Office Of Public Works (OPW), estimated that seven million punts worth of destruction was caused to local property and almost one million punts in losses, was incurred by damage to crops and farm animals.
The report said engineering studies will have to be done before ways of eliminating the flooding can be devised.
